source: CHELSA 2.1 monthly normals 1981-2010 at each town (its own ~3 x 3 km; the 10 km area where that has no value); checked where possible against NOAA GHCN-Daily station normals 1981-2010
policy: Towns whose values disagree with a nearby station are excluded; towns with no usable station are included (unchecked).
fields: n name, c country, x lon, y lat, pop, k Köppen code, w km to the open sea (null if unknown), s 1 = agrees with a nearby station / 0 = no usable station, t 12 monthly mean °C, p 12 monthly mm
